cmake-tools.configuration.cmake.revealLo.value: `true`이면 자동 및 프로그래매틱 CMake 작업이 CMake 출력 채널을 표시합니다. 예를 들어 열기 시 구성, 자동 재구성 그리고 CMake Tools API(예: Copilot을 대신해 동작하는 C/C++ DevTools 동반 기능)를 통해 다른 확장 기능이 호출한 빌드나 테스트가 여기에 해당합니다. `false`(기본값)인 경우 이러한 작업은 CMake 출력 채널을 표시하지 않고 기록되므로 작업 중인 터미널에서 패널을 전환하지 않습니다. `#cmake.revealLog#` 설정은 사용자가 직접 시작한 작업이 로그를 표시하는 방식도 계속 제어합니다. 빌드, 테스트, 구성 실패는 이 설정과 관계없이 항상 표시됩니다.
cmake-tools.configuration.cmake.revealLo.source: When `true`, automatic and programmatic CMake operations - such as configure-on-open, automatic reconfigure, and builds or tests invoked by other extensions through the CMake Tools API (for example the C/C++ DevTools companion acting on behalf of Copilot) - reveal the CMake output channel. When `false` (the default), these operations log silently so they don't switch the panel away from a terminal you are working in. The `#cmake.revealLog#` setting still controls how operations you start yourself reveal the log. Build, test, and configure failures are always shown, regardless of this setting.
cmake-tools.configuration.cmake.revealLo.note: Human-reviewed translation, verified against its English source. Guarded against silent reversion by an automatic localization import.

cmake-tools.configuration.cmake.revealLo.value: Gdy ma wartość `true`, automatyczne i programowe operacje narzędzia CMake — takie jak konfigurowanie przy otwarciu, automatyczna ponowna konfiguracja oraz kompilacje lub testy wywoływane przez inne rozszerzenia za pośrednictwem interfejsu API rozszerzenia CMake Tools (na przykład pomocnicze rozszerzenie C/C++ DevTools działające w imieniu funkcji Copilot) — pokazują kanał wyjściowy narzędzia CMake. Gdy jest to wartość `false` (wartość domyślna), te operacje są rejestrowane w trybie dyskretnym, aby nie przełączały panelu z terminalu, w którym pracujesz. Ustawienie `#cmake.revealLog#` nadal określa, jak dziennik jest wyświetlany w przypadku operacji uruchamianych przez użytkownika. Błędy kompilacji, testowania i konfigurowania są zawsze wyświetlane, niezależnie od tego ustawienia.
cmake-tools.configuration.cmake.revealLo.source: When `true`, automatic and programmatic CMake operations - such as configure-on-open, automatic reconfigure, and builds or tests invoked by other extensions through the CMake Tools API (for example the C/C++ DevTools companion acting on behalf of Copilot) - reveal the CMake output channel. When `false` (the default), these operations log silently so they don't switch the panel away from a terminal you are working in. The `#cmake.revealLog#` setting still controls how operations you start yourself reveal the log. Build, test, and configure failures are always shown, regardless of this setting.
